His youngest daughter asked if the family would now have to “sleep on the streets”. A near-fatal heart emergency in 2020 brought him peace.  Dimon invested heavily in Bank One after leaving Citigroup.  This bold move led to his leadership at JPMorgan Chase.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning

This shift is driven by both comfort and public health concerns. Rising temperatures and extreme heat events are becoming impossible to ignore. Cultural attitudes towards cooling solutions are beginning to change.

title: Barracuda bites Texas girl, 13, but cannot shake her ocean dream

She is now home and preparing for surgery to repair her hand injury. Despite the painful ordeal, Claire still dreams of becoming a marine biologist. Her family shares the story to raise awareness and encourage water safety precautions.

title: Nobel economist challenges Elon Musk to donate his $1 trillion fortune by 2036

title: Why California's largest AI datacenter filed lawsuit seeking Colorado water river

Local cities and the Imperial Irrigation District rejected its initial water requests.  This move raises concerns about the impact on regional farming and jobs.  The data centre promises economic benefits and construction employment opportunities.

title: ‘Made in India’ phones go global: Smartphone exports jump 165 times to Rs 2.59 lakh crore

Mobile phone exports have increased significantly, reaching approximately Rs 2.59 lakh crore by 2025-26. Domestic mobile phone production has also risen around 33 times during the same period. The broader electronics manufacturing base has expanded nearly seven times, with exports growing elevenfold. The government's Semicon India Programme supports semiconductor fabrication, packaging, and chip design capabilities.

title: Payday winners: India’s salary hikes projected at 8.6%-10.2%; who gets the most?

Electrical engineers and quality control inspectors are projected for the strongest salary growth.  Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad lead salary growth across various sectors.  Sustainable growth industries will still post healthy increments for many employees.

title: ITR deadline nears: Here's how to report house property income in tax returns
content: Taxpayers must report all residential property income while filing their Income Tax Return.  Self-occupied properties have a Nil annual value, but deductions are claimable.  Rented properties require reporting gross rent and municipal taxes paid.  Vacant properties may be treated as deemed let-out, requiring notional income calculation.  Accurate reporting prevents discrepancies and ensures eligible deductions are claimed.

content: After quitting her corporate job following marriage, Jaipur-based fashion designer Nishtha Rawat launched her clothing brand, Nehfi, from home in September 2024. Starting with local tailors and managing every aspect of the business herself, she built a contemporary womenswear label inspired by Rajasthani craftsmanship. Within just 10 months, the brand reportedly reached Rs 14 lakh in monthly revenue. Her journey highlights the value of identifying market gaps, prioritising customer trust and scaling thoughtfully.

title: Wife's willingness to resume marriage can't stop divorce, Kerala HC rules

title: Vande Mataram Bill 2026 explained: What changes and what punishment it proposes
content: the amendment is intended to place Vande Mataram on the same legal footing as Jana Gana Mana with respect to protection against insult or disruption . the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971 currently provides statutory protection to the national flag, the Constitution of India, and the National Anthem . under section 3of the Act, it is a punishable offence to intentionally prevent the singing of the national anthem or disturb an assembly engaged in its rendit .
